direction: Later the same day. The draughtsman ties the rolled plan with tape and slides it into a pigeon-hole rack among other rolled survey sheets. The afternoon light fades. Slow pull back. Ambience only.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 still, 1820s estate office in late afternoon light, a lean sandy-haired man in a dark clerk's coat sliding a rolled, tape-tied estate plan into a wooden pigeon-hole rack filled with rolled survey sheets, candle being lit on a desk, plain panelled walls, Cardiff 1824, no text, no heraldry, no crests
